70:t_005:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Nice, nice! It goes perfectly with beer!」

70:t_005:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「For once, I agree with $$マオ$$!」

70:t_005:6.en:
$$ラム$$
「But I might gain weight if I eat this much.」

70:t_005:7.en:
$$ミーナ#pt169$$
「Let's go swimming later. We should make the most of the sea.」

70:t_005:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. It's really delicious.」

70:t_005:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I question the necessity of this situation.」

70:t_005:11.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Is it that unhappy about being used as a hot plate?」

70:t_005:12.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I repeat. I question the necessity of this situation.」

70:t_005:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Shut up, tin can. Your armor's pitch-black, so the sun heats it up enough to use as a hot plate.」

70:t_005:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ブラックオックス#pilot$$ is judged better suited to the task.」

70:t_005:15.en:
$$アル$$
「$$オックス$$ is a child, after all. It can't sit still.」

70:t_005:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「So your suggestions can be useful sometimes. You've gone up in my estimation, $$アル$$.」

70:t_005:17.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I cannot comprehend the situation. Its efficiency is also questionable.」

70:t_005:18.en:
$$レド$$
「Who knew a $$マシンキャリバー$$ could be useful for something besides combat?」

70:t_005:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, I question the necessity of this situation.」

70:t_005:20.en:
$$レド$$
「Necessity aside, the fact is that a lot of people need you right now.」

70:t_005:21.en:
$$レド$$
(Maybe I can find that, too... Someone who needs me for a life beyond being a soldier...)

70:t_006:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...The $$ガルガンティア船団$$... This will be an unforgettable memory...」

70:t_006:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And to protect the peace of this sea, we must move on.」

70:t_006:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'll be sorry to leave, but I suppose it's time.」

70:t_006:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And another battle awaits us ahead...」

75:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

75:t_1:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hahaha! Looks like you've been doing well, $$ワッ太$$!」

75:t_1:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll have you know, things on the $$蒼の地球$$ were rough!」

75:t_1:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Well, so were things on the $$翠の地球$$!」

75:t_1:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But here we are together again.」

75:t_1:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah...! Let's beat the $$サイデリアル$$ bastards and drive them off both Earths!」

75:t_1:10.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$恵子$$, were you and the others in Japan on the $$翠の地球$$?」

75:t_1:11.en:
$$恵子$$
「Yes. We fought $$サイデリアル$$'s attacks on Japan and helped a resistance group on the $$中央大陸$$.」

75:t_1:12.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「It seems we weren't the only ones fighting. Former $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ members are still resisting $$サイデリアル$$ on that continent, too.」

75:t_1:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「So that's why $$サイデリアル$$ and the resistance are evenly matched on this $$中央大陸$$.」

75:t_1:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are the 《$$フリーデン$$》 crew there, too?」

75:t_1:15.en:
$$恵子$$
「We haven't heard anything about $$ジャミル$$ and the others.」

75:t_1:17.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Don't be disappointed. $$ジャミル$$ and the others are probably on the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

75:t_1:19.en:
$$恵子$$
「It corresponds to North America in $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

75:t_1:20.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「After losing $$セントラル・ベース$$ in the north of the $$中央大陸$$, $$サイデリアル$$'s most important base on this planet is there.」

75:t_1:21.en:
$$甲児$$
「So it's basically $$サイデリアル$$'s headquarters on this Earth.」

75:t_1:22.en:
$$恵子$$
「Please watch $$万丈$$'s message disc for more information.」

75:t_1:23.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We were also following his instructions to join you and head for the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

75:t_1:25.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$万丈$$ seems to be acting on his own. We don't know where he is right now, either.」

75:t_1:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Knowing him, he's probably keeping a sharp eye on the enemy's movements.」

75:t_1:27.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Then I'll take Mr. $$破嵐万丈$$'s disc. We'll probably follow his proposal and head for the $$アメリア$$ Continent ourselves.」

75:t_1:28.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So we'll be together again from now on.」

75:t_1:29.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah! I'm counting on you, $$ワッ太$$.」

75:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
「Let me... come on that journey, too.」

75:t_1:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「To fight $$サイデリアル$$ as a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$?」

75:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to learn about this world. So I can live in it.」

75:t_1:37.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「We're coming with you, too. On that journey to learn about the world.」

75:t_1:39.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Actually... That's what we had in mind all along when we came to see you off.」

75:t_1:40.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「That's the story, folks. I'm pretty confident when it comes to machine repairs. I'm counting on you!」

75:t_1:41.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well... We're short-handed, so eager new recruits are more than welcome, but...」

75:t_1:42.en:
$$マオ$$
「Are you sure? There are battles waiting for us where we're headed.」

75:t_1:43.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I understand. But I... want to see this world with my own eyes.」

75:t_1:44.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you sure, $$エイミー$$...? What about $$ベベル$$...?」

75:t_1:45.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$ベベル$$ encouraged me... He asked me to travel for him and tell him everything I see and hear.」

75:t_1:47.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That was my wish and $$ベベル$$'s. I couldn't drag you into it...」

75:t_1:48.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But now I can say it. Let's go together, $$レド$$.」

75:t_1:52.en:
$$アルト$$
「Another one of the quiet types joining us, huh?」

75:t_1:53.en:
$n
「Let me tell you, $$アルト$$. I can't speak for those two, but I'm not the quiet type.」

75:t_1:55.en:
$$アルト$$
「Got it. The sun on the $$残されの海$$ has helped you two look a little more natural when you smile, too.」

75:t_1:56.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So, now that we've got some new friends...」

中央大陸.evidence: Stage 2010b 75:t_1:11-21: continent where resistance and Sidereal are evenly matched; Central Base was in its north. Descriptive geographical name.
中央大陸.resolution_source: Target 40:t_001:6, 46:t_004:14, 75:t_1:11-20. Descriptive geographical label; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z3.R/Story_Summary corroborates the central continent and Sidereal setting. Capitalization is project style.
